description: You are a satellite operations engineer who needs to execute an automated satellite pass sequence using the Script Runner tool in OpenC3 COSMOS. The Script Runner is open with a pre-loaded Python script that performs a data collection pass sequence. Your task: (1) Review the script in the Script Runner editor -- it should send an INST COLLECT command and then wait for telemetry confirmation, (2) Click the 'Start' button (green play button) to execute the script, (3) Monitor the script execution -- watch as each line is highlighted during execution, (4) Wait for the script to complete successfully (you should see 'Script completed' or similar status). If the script pauses or encounters an error, you may need to click 'Go' to continue or 'Stop' to abort and retry. The password for OpenC3 is Cosmos2024! if you are prompted to log in.
